decisions: Gable front plane: 3DBAG wall 35 (t 0..2.3, y to 15.8) stands on the front line while the gable face west of t -0.6 is 1.1-1.3 m behind it; gable windows, slot and cross are placed on the measured wall offsets (-1.3 / -1.25 / -1.1 m) so none hovers.

Gable: two four-light windows (sill 7.6 m, 4.6 m tall) either side of the apex, louvred slot above, stone cross, pointed red door in the gabled porch; offsets measured from the straight-on Ruysdaelstraat 37 photo.

Tower: 20.7 m; stepped brick corbel cornice at 15.2-16.2 m, stone clock stage 16.2-19.8 m with a clock on the north and west faces, two louvre slots on the west face (12.3-15.2 m), stone corner posts.
NOT modelled: round stair turret with oriel (west of the gable at the parsonage), parsonage-wing windows, brick bond. Heights are inferred from 1-point perspective photos.
